import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import odeint

# Rossler attractor equations
def rossler(state, t, a, b, c):
    u, v, w = state
    du = -v - w
    dv = u + a * v
    dw = b + w * (u - c)
    return [du, dv, dw]

# Parameters
a = 0.2
b = 0.2
c = 5.7

# Initial values
initial_state = [1., 1., 1.]

# Time points
t = np.linspace(0, 100, 10000)

# Solve the ODE
solution = odeint(rossler, initial_state, t, args=(a, b, c))
u = solution[:, 0]
v = solution[:, 1]
w = solution[:, 2]

# Create 3D plot
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d')

# Plot the attractor
ax.plot(u, v, w, linewidth=0.5, color='blue')

# Set labels
ax.set_xlabel('u')
ax.set_ylabel('v')
ax.set_zlabel('w')

# Set title
ax.set_title('Rossler Attractor')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('create figure.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as 'create figure.png'")
EOF
